description: Get the coins held in trust by US spot crypto ETFs for one asset or all 16, and the share of the coin's circulating supply they represent (`supplyPct`, percent). Per fund: coins held, share of the asset's ETF coins and `coinsBasis` — reported (published by the issuer, or shares times the published coins per share) or estimated (net assets per share at the same-day coin price, for issuers that do not publish coins). Includes 7- and 30-day changes in coins and the last 30 days of daily history.

asset.description: Optional asset filter: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_etf_holdings
title: Crypto Held by ETFs
